subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No unit test coverage for the new live_preview config. The existing test file (src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts) has tests for CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT config but none verify that live_preview is correctly populated from CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST / CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN env vars, or that enable is false when the host is absent. The total test count is not increased to cover this new feature.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test cases to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts (in a new describe('live_preview config') block) that: (1) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require the module, and assert options.live_preview.enable is true with correct host and management_token values; (2) leave them unset and assert options.live_preview.enable is false.

issues.description: management_token is always present in the live_preview object even when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is an empty string. While harmless when enable is false, it is cleaner to conditionally include it only when a token exists, matching the pattern already used for CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT (conditional spread).
issues.suggestedFix: Use conditional spread: live_preview: { enable: Boolean(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST), host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, ...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {}) }
